text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 fired — service=runtime-serving, region=us-west, metric=p99_latency > 1200ms (5m window)
pagerduty: INC-2026 created, routed to #eng-oncall. escalation_timer=8m.
alice: acked. I'm on it — taking initial triage.
bob: ack. standby if you need help.
incident-bot: ack registered by alice.
alice: quick check of dashboards: p99=1400ms, p95=460ms, error-rate stable. Spike started ~2m ago.
carol: looking at edge proxy, traffic is ~2x for several tenants (spiky requests from a partner).
dave-sre: autoscaler failing to scale — HPA desired=12 but current=8, pending due to node quota. Investigating.
alice: mitigation plan: 1) short-term increase concurrency, 2) restart a subset of sidecars to evict stale KV, 3) route overflow to fallback model pool.
alice: running restart on a canary set:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-serving -n prod --selector=canary=true
```
carol: updating routing policy to route 15% overflow to model-pool-secondary (region=us-west-fallback). Applying now.
carol: routing change applied — policy id=rp-87.
bob: bumped worker max_concurrency to 64 in the scaling group for immediate relief.
dave-sre: draining one overloaded node to force new pods on healthier capacity.
eve-support: drafting customer note: "We are experiencing elevated inference latency in US-West affecting a subset of requests. Engineers are investigating and applying mitigations." Will post to status page in a minute.
alice: watching logs — saw some KV cache misses spike, likely due to restart churn + traffic burst. Warming cache on new pods.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: next escalation in 5m if not resolved.
bob: metrics: p99 -> 980ms now, p95 -> 320ms. Slow but improving.
alice: p99 trending 720ms, p95 280ms. no 5xx increase.
carol: confirmed fallback pool serving ~12% of requests, tail latency there ~350ms. Good fallback.
dave-sre: autoscaler issue root cause: cloud quota hit on ephemeral volume attachments. Raised limit request, meanwhile manually provisioned 2 nodes.
alice: coordinating with infra to keep scale until traffic normalizes.
eve-support: status page update posted, customers notified to targeted list.
bob: p99 now 430ms sustained for 2m.
alice: good. I'll let it run on watch for 10m, then close if stable.
carol: I'll leave routing policy as-is for 15m then rollback.
dave-sre: node pool increased + drained bad host. infra will monitor.
alice: marking incident as mitigated. Preparing to resolve pager once we hit steady-state.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-2026 acknowledged by alice.
bob: thanks everyone.
alice: closing notes: cause=traffic burst + autoscaler quota blocking scale -> cache churn -> elevated p99. Mitigations: manual node provision, routing overflow, concurrency bump, canary restarts to warm cache. Follow-ups: request quota increase, add prewarming for cache on scale events, improve HPA health checks.
eve-support: posting final update to status page.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026 resolved by alice.
